message.reasoning_content:
We need to determine appropriate criminal charges based on facts.

Facts: multiple burglaries (theft) with cash and goods, plus arson (setting fire) to destroy evidence. So charges: theft (盗窃) and arson (放火) or arson for destroying evidence. In Chinese criminal law, arson is "放火罪". The description: "故意放火" to destroy evidence, which is arson. So charges: 盗窃;放火.

Check examples: earlier similar case: "抢夺" etc. For arson they used "放火". Yes.

Thus answer: [罪名]盗窃;放火<eoa>
